name: Olivia
source:
A lady in name only, Olivia was sent to court to find a husband. She was quickly seduced by [url=https://vndb.org/c165638]Rebeus[/url]. She has formed a close friendship and friend-with-benefits relationship with the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. While many young maidens come and go, Livvy has managed to stay a favourite of the Princes.
